title: Alarm clock with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bells on top -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='13' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='13' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='8' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='8' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- bell stems -->
  <rect x='26' y='30' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <rect x='70' y='30' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='10' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <rect x='60' y='82' width='10' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='33' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='28' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='24' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- hour ticks -->
  <rect x='49' y='32' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='49' y='73' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='27' y='54' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='68' y='54' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <!-- smiling face -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='48' r='4' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='48' r='4' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 60 Q50 70 60 60' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='57' r='4' fill='#FFAB91'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='57' r='4' fill='#FFAB91'/>
  <!-- clock hands -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='50' y2='40' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='62' y2='58' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <!-- top handle -->
  <path d='M42 24 Q50 16 58 24' stroke='#FF8F00' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
